description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing and manipulating 'StatisticsEvent' entities in a SQL database, including custom query methods for retrieving and deleting events based on various filters.
external_methods: Page<StatisticsEventEntity> findEvents(UUID, UUID, Long, Long, Pageable)
void removeEvents(UUID, UUID, Long, Long, String, Integer, Integer, Integer, Integer)

classes.name: StatisticsEventRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for 'StatisticsEvent' entities, extending JpaRepository and custom EventRepository, with methods for querying and deleting statistics events.

methods.name: findLatestEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the latest statistics events for a specific tenant and entity, limited by a specified number.

methods.name: findEvents
methods.description: Fetches paginated statistics events filtered by tenant, entity, and optional time range.

methods.name: findEvents (overloaded)
methods.description: Fetches paginated statistics events with additional filters such as service ID, message processed counts, and error counts.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Deletes events for a specific tenant and entity within an optional time range.

methods.name: removeEvents (overloaded)
methods.description: Deletes events with additional filters such as service ID, message processed counts, and error counts.
